sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Against the Conscience - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "So you're saying you were in the last champion's apartment? All right then. I'll pretend like it never happened. Just remember, curiosity killed the cat. And the last champion, too. He was a good guy, I liked him, but he got soft, lost his touch. You should be practicing more, not wandering around the city. Otherwise, your ranking will start to drop."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Eliminate 100 enemies in any game mode in Arena
Seasonal change: Ref instead asks seasonal characters to eliminate 20 PMC operatives in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +23,000 EXP
- Ref Rep +0.04
- 100 GP coins
  - 105 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 115 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
"There you go! Time should be spent improving your skills. Who knows what happens if you don't?"
